scenes.heading: Understanding your true margins before scaling ad spend

sents.d: Understanding your true margins before scaling ad spend
Know your real contribution margin before you spend more to acquire customers.

Revenue alone doesn't tell you what you can afford to spend on advertising — you need contribution margin per unit, which factors in cost of goods, shipping, packaging, payment processing fees, and an assumption for returns.

scenes.heading: Set a maximum cost per customer

sents.d: Once you know that number, you can set a realistic maximum customer acquisition cost and evaluate ad campaigns against it, rather than judging campaigns by revenue or clicks alone.
Scaling ad spend before this math is solid is one of the most common ways new e-commerce sellers turn apparent growth into real losses.

take: Know your margin per unit before you scale ads.
